list.name: ai-memory
list.description: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors

list.name: xerj
list.description: Local-first search engine and MCP server for AI agents. One Rust binary indexes code, docs, logs, JSONL/CSV and PDFs for BM25 full-text, vector and hybrid search, code search without grep, agent memory and RAG. Elasticsearch-compatible API; Corpus Hub serves hundreds of reference memory corpora.

list.name: bun
list.description: Incredibly fast JavaScript runtime, bundler, test runner, and package manager – all in one

list.name: openpencil
list.description: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.

list.name: Konnect
list.description: AI-assisted PCB design for KiCAD 10. Native KiCAD plugin — a single Rust binary exposing 217 schematic, layout, routing, placement, design-review, and manufacturing tools to Claude, or the LLM of your choosing

list.name: Codync
